notablePrerequisites: Forensic Researcher and Vizier of Tumbling Sands do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Forensic Researcher triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Vizier of Tumbling Sands triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbling Sands ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.
